t01.reason: Paul, 2026-10-14 (Popfly review task, checkpoint 0 decisions 2 and 3): the 50 pages of scan 8e03985c plus /overland for P2-013. Municipal sites stay at the default.

declared_exclusions.note: Applied only to requests that miss the HAR. A request that matches is counted as a declared exclusion instead of invalidating the run. Requests found in the HAR are always served. Version 2 (2026-10-14, first real-site replay, tuning-v1): adds Google Ads beacons (google.com/ccm, google.com/rmkt) and the OpenAI pixel, whose URLs carry per-load random parameters; Instagram and YouTube embed internals (third-party iframes whose requests vary per load); and media resources (audio and video are range-requested and cannot be served from a HAR). A CONNECT that bypasses page routing reaches the deny proxy showing only its host; it is still refused and counts as a declared hit when that host matches a declared pattern's host.

check_classification.note: Behavioral checks interact with the live page or build prompts from interaction state; their repeatability is reported as a flake rate. Non-behavioral checks must replay identically.

criteria.name: Non-text Content
criteria.note: axe checks that text alternatives exist (image-alt, input-image-alt, object-alt, role-img-alt, svg-img-alt). alt-text asks the model about the quality of existing alts, with the fetched image when available. Decorative vs informative judgement and complex images need a human.

criteria.name: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.note: No check. The scanner marks 1.2.x not_applicable only when no audio or video element appears in the captured DOM.

criteria.name: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.note: axe video-caption checks only that a captions track element exists, not that captions are accurate.

criteria.name: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.note: No check.

criteria.name: Captions (Live)
criteria.note: No check.

criteria.name: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.note: No check.

criteria.name: Info and Relationships
criteria.note: axe list, definition-list, table header and required ARIA parent/child rules; headings flags empty headings and body text styled as headings; landmark-labels and table-structure are rule-based DOM checks. Visual relationships without markup are not detected.

criteria.name: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.note: No check; reported not_tested.

criteria.name: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.note: No check; reported not_tested.

criteria.name: Orientation
criteria.note: axe css-orientation-lock is experimental and not enabled; reported not_tested.

criteria.name: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.note: axe autocomplete-valid checks token validity; input-purpose asks the model which fields collect user data and lack autocomplete.

criteria.name: Use of Color
criteria.note: axe link-in-text-block; form-submission flags error elements with no text as colour-only. Other colour-only meaning is not detected (use_of_color prompt is unwired).

criteria.name: Audio Control
criteria.note: axe no-autoplay-audio only.

criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.note: axe color-contrast. Text over images or gradients comes back incomplete and is routed to needs_review.

criteria.name: Resize Text
criteria.note: axe meta-viewport only checks that zoom is not disabled; text resize to 200% is not tested.

criteria.name: Images of Text
criteria.note: No check; reported not_tested.

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.note: No check; reported not_tested.

criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
criteria.note: focus-visible measures focus indicator contrast but reports it under 2.4.7; other UI component and graphics contrast is not checked.

criteria.name: Text Spacing
criteria.note: axe avoid-inline-spacing only checks inline !important spacing styles.

criteria.name: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.note: No check (content_on_hover_focus prompt is unwired); reported not_tested.

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.note: keyboard records a Tab sweep and compares it with interactive candidates; axe frame-focusable-content, scrollable-region-focusable and server-side-image-map. Operability of custom widgets beyond reachability is not tested.

criteria.name: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.note: Presses Tab repeatedly and flags focus cycles confined to a container.

criteria.name: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.note: No check; reported not_tested.

criteria.name: Timing Adjustable
criteria.note: axe meta-refresh only; session timeouts are not tested.

criteria.name: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.note: axe blink and marquee; pause-stop-hide is a DOM indicator for autoplaying carousels, animations and video without controls.

criteria.name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.note: DOM indicator for video and animation that might flash; no frame analysis.

criteria.name: Bypass Blocks
criteria.note: axe bypass; skip-nav activates the first skip link and checks focus moves to the target.

criteria.name: Page Titled
criteria.note: axe document-title checks presence only, not whether the title describes the page.

criteria.name: Focus Order
criteria.note: Compares Tab order with visual position; meaning-preserving order needs a human.

criteria.name: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.note: axe link-name and area-alt; link-text asks the model whether link text and context convey purpose; duplicate-links is rule-based.

criteria.name: Multiple Ways
criteria.note: DOM indicator for navigation, search and sitemap links.

criteria.name: Headings and Labels
criteria.note: Only empty or non-descriptive headings fail; labels are not evaluated.

criteria.name: Focus Visible
criteria.note: Screenshot comparison of focused and unfocused states for each Tab stop.

criteria.name: Pointer Gestures
criteria.note: No check; reported not_tested.

criteria.name: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.note: No check; reported not_tested.

criteria.name: Label in Name
criteria.note: axe label-content-name-mismatch is experimental and not enabled.

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.note: DOM indicator for device motion listeners.

criteria.name: Language of Page
criteria.note: axe html-has-lang, html-lang-valid, html-xml-lang-mismatch; whether the declared language matches the content is not checked.

criteria.name: Language of Parts
criteria.note: axe valid-lang validates lang attribute values only; unmarked language changes are not found.

criteria.name: On Focus
criteria.note: No check; reported not_tested.

criteria.name: On Input
criteria.note: Changes each visible field, blurs it and watches for navigation, dialogs, large DOM mutations or new elements; flags changes for review. Only forms with visible fields at load.

criteria.name: Consistent Navigation
criteria.note: Groups navigation regions across crawled pages and asks the model about order, missing items and label changes.

criteria.name: Consistent Identification
criteria.note: Prompt is unwired; reported not_tested.

criteria.name: Error Identification
criteria.note: Submits empty and invalid values with submissions contained; only forms with visible fields at load.

criteria.name: Labels or Instructions
criteria.note: axe form-field-multiple-labels only (labels_or_instructions prompt is unwired); missing labels surface under 4.1.2 via axe label.

criteria.name: Error Suggestion
criteria.note: Model evaluates error messages captured after contained submissions.

criteria.name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.note: Rule-based risk classification, then the model checks safeguards from form HTML (no screenshot is sent).

criteria.name: Parsing
criteria.note: axe duplicate-id rules are deprecated and do not run. The 2023 WCAG 2.1 errata treat 4.1.1 as always satisfied for HTML; the engine records nothing for it.

criteria.name: Name, Role, Value
criteria.note: axe ARIA, button-name, label, select-name, frame-title and related rules; widget-aria checks Webflow tabs, dropdowns, accordions and custom interactive elements.

criteria.name: Status Messages
criteria.note: No check.
